levels.surface: عبد العزيز بن عبد الله بن أبي سلمة

notes: The text writes no convergence cue («قالا», «جميعا», «كلهم») after its «ح»: the second branch writes its own names, so the two branches are kept as separate groups with a null tail (rule 3).
««بهذا الإسناد» closes the second route only; the first route ends where the text stops repeating names.
«عن عمه، الماجشون بن أبي سلمة»: «عمه» + name, one link with the name alone (rule 7).
